name: BMW F30
subtitle: ENET (HSFZ)
info:
BMW F30 / F31

Minimal UNVERIFIED catalog: it only lists control units, with no status pages or activations.
F-series cars use HSFZ over Ethernet (ENET), not CAN. You need an OBD-to-RJ45 ENET cable (with the activation line on OBD pin 8) and the phone connected to the car through an ENET-to-USB/WiFi bridge or an Ethernet adapter. In Settings leave the host on "auto" or enter the car IP. Ignition on. K+DCAN and ELM adapters are NOT valid for this transport.

The SGBD names in this catalog are unchecked: verify them against your own data files (ecu folder).
Use Identification, Faults and All jobs to explore; add status pages to the JSON once you have checked them.
